name: Sakakura Juuzou
source: Sakakura Juuzou is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 6 Director. His responsibility as the director is maintaining public order via suppression of insurrection, inquiry regarding special criminals, including the Special Crime Investigation Unit featured in Danganronpa Gaiden: Killer Killer. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.
